text:
Mira: starting Velocity POC kickoff for Prospect Orion. Objective: steady 120 qps gen, with controlled microbursts to 2500 qps for 15s to validate tail behavior and autoscale. Need runbook, cost estimate for Hosted bursts, and BYOK/KMS workflow. Priya please lead test plan. Max infra.
Priya: on it. couple quicks: average prompt size? typical generate tokens? any embed traffic? do they require data redaction before we ingest?
Mira: prompts ~180-320 tokens, generations ~150 tokens average. embeddings <10% of calls. yes, redact PII; customer will only provide sanitized examples.
Jorge: security: they require BYOK with HSM option, TLS1.3 mandatory, and an encrypted SFTP transfer for samples. Also will ask for SOC2 cert and a short answers doc for their vendor questionnaire.
Max: infra notes: Hosted can hit 2500 spikes but need prewarm and transient capacity reservation. estimate Hosted incremental cost during spikes (13B quantized) ~ $1.8k/hr when spike active. Dedicated for predictable bursts: recommend 10 GPUs for safe headroom; monthly commit increases significantly.
Priya: draft runbook:
1) provision test cluster with attached KMS alias
2) smoke tests at 30 qps
3) concurrency sweep (20 -> 180)
4) sustained phase (120 qps, 25m)
5) burst rehearsals: 15s and 60s at 2500 qps
6) collect metrics: p50/p95/p99 latencies, 5xx counts, GPU util, KV cache hit rate, token burn
Sample client command for load generator:
```bash
rbx-loadgen --model redwood-13b-q4_0 --target-qps 120 --spike-qps 2500 --spike-seconds 15 --concurrency 100 --prewarm-seconds 600 --header "x-customer-id:orion-redacted" 
```
Mark payloads REDACTED.
Max: infra checklist: bind KMS alias `orion/byok` to cluster, enable prewarm=10m, set autoscale headroom to 30%, enable retry backoff on client side for 500s during spike ramp, create dashboards for p99/error-rate/token-cost.
deploy-bot: provisioned cluster id=orion-poc-02, nodes=7 g5s.xlarge-equivalent, endpoint=orion-poc-02.redwood.internal:443
Priya: redacted sample payload for internal tests: {"prompt":"Summarize invoice #REDACTED","max_tokens":150}. add header `x-data-class: redacted`.
Max: quick initial smoke results on orion-poc-02:
- 30 qps: p95 95ms, p99 260ms
- 120 qps sustained: p95 180ms, p99 740ms
- 2500 qps 15s spike: median under 450ms but tail spikes reached ~2.1s; ~0.3% transient 5xx at ramp onset when cache cold. with prewarm + short client retries 5xx resolved. Attached small CSV with sampled metrics.
Mira: solid. Priya please finalize runbook and cost workbook by Monday EOD. include Hosted vs Dedicated SLA and an estimated charge for rehearsal spikes.
Priya: will upload runbook + cost sheet to internal drive and create a customer-ready redacted copy for review. link once available.
Max: scheduling full rehearsal Tues 08:30 PT; Eng-SRE please standby to monitor p99 and error surge.
Eng-SRE: on call Tues 08:30 PT. will watch error budgets and autoscale events.
Jorge: customer requested demo Thu 10am PT. can we confirm after Tue rehearsal?
Mira: locking Thu 10am PT pending rehearsal results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
